get.summary: Read-only current admin inspection of this tenant's retained objects
get.description: Includes referenced, pending, trash and orphan objects. No SQL rows, global schema/credential digests, whole-service backup, object bytes or automatic deletion. Existing authenticated read wrapper validates current membership/session; service acquires shared maintenance82002 after shared auth82003. Expired or revoked rights are reported as current denial counts and remain valid archival state. Missing mandatory objects and mismatched declared hashes are integrity issues; absent planned staging keys are optional.
